name: desi_web_responsive
description: A modern, responsive web application for SavoryBite showcasing authentic Indian cuisine, food menus, recipes, and a contact interface. Built with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

paragraphs: A clean, modern, and fully responsive website designed for SavoryBite, highlighting authentic Indian cuisine with an engaging user experience, intuitive navigation, and smooth UI across all device sizes.
🚀 Live Demo: savorybite-gagan.netlify.app 📁 GitHub Repository: github.com/Gagan-3/desiwebresponsive
features: 📱 100% Mobile First & Responsive Design: Optimized for smartphones, tablets, laptops, and wide desktop screens.
🎨 Modern & Aesthetic UI: Custom styling, vibrant culinary visual aesthetics, and smooth hover interactions.
🍔 Interactive Menu & Recipes: Categorized dishes, custom recipe guides, and clear pricing structure.
📍 Contact & Booking Section: Easy access to restaurant details, location info, and inquiry forms.
🔍 SEO Ready: Complete with robots.txt and sitemap.xml for optimal search engine indexing.
